description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md -- the opening lines say what the software does.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues and contribute.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, sign-off, signed commits and the repository's full check are required.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_interface_justification: README.md and source/brand-book.md document the token names, classes and components a consumer uses. (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md)
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues and PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; see the commit history.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks the changes, who made them, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between releases are visible in git history.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique vX.Y.Z tag, and a published tag is never reused.
version_semver_justification: README.md#versions describes the vX.Y.Z policy: removing or renaming a token, class or file is major.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md -- human-readable, not a raw git log. CHANGELOG.md and each GitHub Release's notes.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE has been assigned against this project. SECURITY.md's process commits to a published advisory if one is.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/issues (see also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug report from outside the organization has been opened to date, so none is unanswered. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a vulnerability report within 7 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/issues
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: Nothing to build: the repository is used as committed source files.
test_justification: `node --test` runs test/design-tokens.test.mjs: resolver parity with source/tokens.json, plus credit-file checks.
test_invocation_justification: The standard command for this ecosystem is documented in CLAUDE.md's Commands table and README.md#development.
test_most_justification: node --test --experimental-test-coverage measures 84.57% of lines and 87.39% of branches of the project's JavaScript, and CI enforces a floor of 80% of each.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the suite on every push and PR.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- new behaviour needs tests and a fix needs a regression test.
tests_are_added_justification: test/design-tokens.test.mjs is updated with every token change, as CLAUDE.md requires.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests and the pull request template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: CI runs shellcheck on bin/*.sh, actionlint and zizmor on the workflows, and CodeQL on every push and PR.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings from these tools fail the required `verify` or CodeQL check, so none is merged unfixed.
warnings_strict_justification: Not applicable: no compiler or linter flag to make strict; shellcheck, actionlint and zizmor fail the verify job on any finding.
know_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md states the scope, secrets handling and accepted risks; the maintainers also keep m3l-groundwork's docs/assurance-case.md (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md), which maps the Saltzer and Schroeder principles.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE Top 25 table, kept by the same maintainers, names the vulnerability types and the mitigation for each.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project stores no passwords for authenticating users.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only through GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability within 60 days; none is open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml runs a second scan on every push and PR.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup) analyzes every push and PR, more often than each release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL is a required check on `main`, so a confirmed finding is fixed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: JavaScript or TypeScript on a managed runtime.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis tool is run, so there is nothing to run with assertions enabled. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: The organization's default repository permission is read; write access is granted by hand.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires a pull request with a code-owner approval and the required checks, with an empty bypass list. Direct pushes are rejected.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The `main` ruleset blocks deletion of the branch, with an empty bypass list.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates event metadata into a script: values reach `run:` steps through `env:`. zizmor, which flags template injection, runs in CI and reports no findings.
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow uses `pull_request_target` or `workflow_run`. Pull-request workflows hold read-only tokens and no secrets, except the org Gitleaks license, which the Gitleaks job needs.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official project URL (the repository, the issue tracker and the security advisory form) is served over HTTPS by GitHub.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The only distribution channel is GitHub, over HTTPS. Release assets are checked against `SHA256SUMS` by `bin/sync-design.sh`.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml scans every push and PR. Both are required checks.
osps_do_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md is the user guide for every function the project offers.
osps_do_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-a-bug explains how to report a defect.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues is open for discussion of changes and usage problems: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/issues
osps_gv_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process, including that pull requests are limited to collaborators.
osps_le_02_01_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition. The two bundled fonts are SIL OFL-1.1, also OSI-approved.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Released assets carry the same MIT license. Fonts keep OFL-1.1.
osps_le_03_02_justification: The release archive contains the LICENSE file. `source/LICENSE` is inside the release tarball.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: git history on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The project has no package-managed dependencies: it has no package manifest, and every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project is a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executable artifacts.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are two WOFF2 fonts (Atkinson Hyperlegible, SIL OFL-1.1). They are not executable, their provenance and license are in `source/fonts/FONTLOG.md`, and `SHA256SUMS` pins their hashes.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability gives the private advisory form and the 7-day acknowledgment target.
code_of_conduct_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, the organization default that applies to this repository. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conduct links it.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity -- both owners hold administration independently, the ruleset requires signed commits and not a particular key, and each keeps an emergency access kit.
bus_factor_justification: Honestly 1 today: both owners have full access and one approves nearly every change, but one person has authored all 33 pull requests written by a person. See https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#bus-factor. This is a Gold criterion.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are updated in the same pull request as the behavior they describe (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pull-request). The docs kit's --check, which CI runs, fails a doc that names a token tokens.css does not declare or a newest changelog release that is not the adopted version.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md links the OpenSSF Best Practices and Baseline badges (project 15706), the Scorecard badge and the REUSE badge.
sites_password_security_justification: No project-controlled site stores passwords: the docs site is static HTML and GitHub handles every account.
maintenance_or_update_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support -- only the latest release is supported, and the upgrade path is one command, bin/sync-design.sh vX.Y.Z, with a changelog entry for every release and a BREAKING CHANGE footer naming anything removed or renamed (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#versioning-policy).
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability report has been resolved yet. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit says how a reporter is credited.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names the standards for each kind of file: Biome's recommended rules with useTemplate as an error, ES modules with no dependency in the resolver and docs kit, shellcheck-clean shell, per-job workflow permissions, .editorconfig, and the m3l-design markdown rules.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: Biome lints all the project's JavaScript on every pull request and push, in the Checks lane of https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml, with its recommended rules and useTemplate as an error (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/biome.json). The version is pinned in tools/lint. Shell (shellcheck), workflows (actionlint and zizmor), licensing (reuse lint), generated files and the docs site are enforced too. Biome's formatter is off, so layout follows .editorconfig and is checked in review.
build_standard_variables_justification: The project builds no native binaries.
build_non_recursive_justification: There is no build or installation system: generated files come from one script, bin/build-design-tokens.mjs.
build_repeatable_justification: bin/package-release.sh builds the release from a commit with git archive and gzip -n, so one commit always gives the same bytes. test/scripts.test.mjs runs it twice and compares the hash of every asset. CI also regenerates tokens.css and SHA256SUMS and fails on any difference (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml).
build_preserve_debug_justification: Nothing is compiled, so there is no debugging information to preserve.
build_reproducible_justification: See build_repeatable: the release assets are byte-for-byte the same from the same commit, and test/scripts.test.mjs checks it.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#quickstart -- bin/sync-design.sh vX.Y.Z <repo> copies a verified release in, and removing the design/ directory and its marker uninstalls it. There is nothing installed outside the target repository.
installation_standard_variables_justific: There is no installation system with a location convention: the target is the directory given to bin/sync-design.sh.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup -- clone, then run the checks. There is no package.json and nothing to install.
dependency_monitoring_justification: The release payload has no dependency. The two npm tools (tools/deploy and tools/lint) are watched by Dependabot weekly (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml), and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a PR that adds a high-severity vulnerability. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings is the policy.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml -- the Checks lane runs node --test on every pull request and every push to main. The suite includes the resolver, the brand build, the docs kit's build, markdown, parity and live-site tests, the two command-line entry points, and test/scripts.test.mjs, which runs bin/sync-design.sh and bin/package-release.sh against a scratch repository.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pull-request makes a regression test a MUST. Since the repository started on 2026-10-11, 4 of its 8 behavior fixes changed a file under test/ (the other fixes are wording).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: node --test --experimental-test-coverage measures 84.57% of lines and 87.39% of branches over all the project's JavaScript (the scripts, the resolver and the docs kit, including the two command-line entry points, which run as child processes), and the Checks lane of https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml fails below 80% of either. Node does not measure the two shell scripts: test/scripts.test.mjs checks their behavior instead.
input_validation_justification: bin/sync-design.sh accepts only a tag matching ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$, a consumer marker with a Version copied or Version adopted line, and a payload whose hashes match SHA256SUMS, and rejects everything else before writing; test/scripts.test.mjs checks the tag and marker rejections. The resolver's assertResolverShape rejects a token manifest of another shape at load time.
crypto_used_network_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own. bin/sync-design.sh calls the gh CLI and standard checksum tools, and the docs site is static HTML.
crypto_tls12_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own. bin/sync-design.sh calls the gh CLI and standard checksum tools, and the docs site is static HTML.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own. bin/sync-design.sh calls the gh CLI and standard checksum tools, and the docs site is static HTML.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own. bin/sync-design.sh calls the gh CLI and standard checksum tools, and the docs site is static HTML.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own. bin/sync-design.sh calls the gh CLI and standard checksum tools, and the docs site is static HTML.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No embedded cryptographic credentials are used, and the software stores none.
signed_releases_justification: Each release asset carries a Sigstore-backed attestation made in GitHub Actions, with no long-lived private key on any site. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#verifying-a-release documents how to verify it with gh release verify, gh release verify-asset and gh attestation verify, and bin/sync-design.sh runs the first two before it writes anything.
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are lightweight tags made by release-please, and the commits they point at are signed. Releases are immutable, so a tag cannot be moved. This criterion is only suggested.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the required DCO sign-off check.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: Every text and UI pairing is held to WCAG 2.2 AA and tabulated per theme in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/source/foundations/contrast.md. Motion drops to zero under prefers-reduced-motion, and the docs site is static HTML built from the same components.
internationalization_justification: The software generates no end-user text: the components are HTML and CSS that carry the consumer's own content, and the scripts print developer-facing status text.
interfaces_current_justification: The Node line is pinned in .node-version, JavaScript is ES modules only (a hook blocks CommonJS), and the resolver and docs kit have no dependency that could pull in a deprecated API.
hardening_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/ -- every workflow starts from read-only or empty permissions, every action is pinned to a commit SHA, and the docs site is served with a content security policy, HSTS and nosniff.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: The same gate requires 80% branch coverage, and the measured value is 87.39%: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: Statement coverage of the JavaScript is 84.57% of lines. The gate is 80%, and the shell scripts have no line coverage.
two_person_review_justification: The main ruleset requires an approval from a code owner who is not the author, with no bypass. 30 of the 33 pull requests written by a person had one, and the other 3 landed before the ruleset (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet).
require_2FA_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member. It is an organization setting, and the GitHub API reports two_factor_requirement_enabled as true for the organization (checked 2026-11-17). https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security says which second factors are acceptable.
contributors_unassociated_justification: Both people with access belong to the monte3l organization; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet.
security_review_justification: No independent security review has been done. The maintainers' own analysis is in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md.
hardened_site_justification: https://design.monte3l.com serves Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers, and the daily docs-live check fails if what is served differs from what is built.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: The default workflow permission is read (a repository setting the org baseline checks), and every workflow sets permissions: at the top: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/.
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Permissions are set per job and each write scope sits in the job that needs it: pull-requests in labeler.yml's label job, id-token and attestations in release.yml's finalize call, and security-events and id-token in scorecard.yml. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Collaborator-controlled input reaches a shell only through env: variables. The DCO lane in verify.yml receives the commit range and author that way and never inline, and zizmor, which runs on every workflow change, reports no unsuppressed finding.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Every release has a unique semantic version tag, vX.Y.Z, and a published tag is never reused: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/releases.
osps_br_02_02_justification: A release's three assets are attached to that release, and the tarball is named for its tag, m3l-design-vX.Y.Z.tar.gz: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/bin/package-release.sh.
osps_br_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md is written by release-please from Conventional Commits for every release, grouped as Added, Changed and Fixed, with a BREAKING CHANGE footer for anything removed or renamed.
osps_br_05_01_justification: The only dependencies are two CI tools, the deploy tool and the linter, each in a package.json and a committed package-lock.json under tools/, installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts. The release payload has none.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Every release asset carries a Sigstore-backed attestation, and SHA256SUMS lists the hash of every payload file: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#verifying-a-release.
osps_br_07_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets-and-credentials states what the project does not store, inventories every secret, and sets how they are stored, accessed and rotated.
osps_do_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#verifying-a-release gives the commands that check a release and its assets, and the checksum check for a copy.
osps_do_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#verifying-a-release names the expected signer, the shared release workflow in monte3l/.github running for this repository, and gives the gh attestation verify command that checks it.
osps_do_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states what is covered, the latest release, and for how long.
osps_do_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states that a release stops receiving security fixes when the next one is published.
osps_do_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-dependency describes how a dependency is selected, obtained and tracked. The payload has none.
osps_do_07_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/README.md#working-on-this-repo. There is no package.json and nothing to install beyond Node 24, reuse, shellcheck and jq.
osps_gv_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles names enri3l and giulmonte, the only people with access.
osps_gv_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards and #scope-of-a-pull-request name the standards and the required gates.
osps_gv_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#granting-access is the policy: only an owner grants access, with the other owner's agreement, after a track-record check and an identity check, at the least privilege that works.
osps_le_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the required DCO sign-off check.
osps_qa_02_02_justification: The release assets are a git archive of source files, CSS and fonts, a checksum list and one CSS file. Nothing is compiled, so there is no compiled software asset to attach a software bill of materials to.
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The main ruleset requires the status checks verify, Dependency Review, CodeQL, Gitleaks, DCO sign-off and Commit lint, with no bypass actors and a branch that is up to date.
osps_qa_04_02_justification: This is one repository. Consumers hold a copy of a release, and they are separate repositories with their own checks, not subprojects built into this one.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: verify runs on every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#test-environments-and-how-tests-run lists each kind of check, where it runs, what triggers it and how to run it by hand.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The main ruleset requires one approving review from a code owner other than the author, approval of the last push and dismissal of stale approvals, with no bypass actors.
osps_sa_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/docs/architecture.md#external-interfaces describes the sync script, the release assets, the public API, the token generator, the docs kit and the docs site.
osps_vm_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#response-process publishes an advisory after a fix. No advisory has been needed so far.
osps_vm_04_02_justification: No published vulnerability has been judged not exploitable, so there is nothing to record. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#vulnerabilities-that-do-not-affect-the-project says where it would go.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#remediation-thresholds. A pull request that fails the dependency checks cannot merge, and a release is cut from main.
osps_vm_05_03_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a PR on a high-severity finding or a license outside the allow-list, and Dependabot and CodeQL cover the rest. The check is required on main.
osps_vm_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/SECURITY.md#remediation-thresholds: a new CodeQL alert of error severity or critical or high security severity blocks the PR, and one in merged code is fixed within 60 days of triage.
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL default setup analyzes every push and PR, and the CodeQL check is required on main. By GitHub's default it fails on a new alert of error severity or critical or high security severity.
external_dependencies_justification: The release payload, the resolver and the docs kit have no dependency. The external dependencies are two CI tools, the deploy tool (wrangler) and the linter (Biome), listed in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/tools/deploy/package.json and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/tools/lint/package.json and pinned with integrity hashes in each package-lock.json.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: The two CI tools are pinned by committed lockfiles and updated through Dependabot pull requests (weekly, after a one-day cooldown), and every GitHub Action is pinned to a commit SHA that Dependabot also updates: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-design/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml.
